context:
Goal: a red main never ships to sessions, and merges resume fast after a revert.
Problem (rule): two of your words differ. (1) Nov 4, 15:21 and 15:27 CST, in chat to the coordinator, recorded in decision no-merge-onto-red-main: the merge tool refuses `merge --confirm` while main's newest completed run is red; only a newer completed green run clears it. (2) Nov 12, 09:46 CST you typed 'q3: is fine' and, confirmed 09:48 CST, 'q3 correct', choosing option i of Q3. The record (plans/owner-rulings-2026-11-12.md, r42) reads that as the third option: 'a red main stops merges only until the revert merges'. You did not type those words, and #3049's body words the same option 'until the revert's run on main is green'. At 14:13 CST Nov 12 you told the retrospective to decide item 622 (your page note: 'ask retrospective session to decide this since i spoke it on there though'); it picked b, which follows your 09:46 answer. #3049's body says merges resume 'until the revert's run on main is green'. Main does the green-run rule today. Changing it either way needs your word.
Based on (ruling): decision no-merge-onto-red-main (Nov 4); your 09:46 CST Nov 12 answer (item 622 context); R26 (Nov 11, as the coordinator reports it): a red main is fixed before the next merge.
Departs from: main — main does the green-run rule today; b changes it.
Meanwhile: main keeps the green-run rule; the lane that would have built b is archived and builds nothing until you answer.

options.gain: A broken revert cannot reopen merges.
options.how: Main keeps what it does today: the merge tool refuses `merge --confirm` until a newer completed run on main is green. Ruling ow-29 is rewritten to match.
options.label: Merges resume when the revert's own run on main is green (recommended)
options.lose: Merges wait for the revert's run to finish after the revert merges.

options.gain: Merges resume as soon as the revert lands.
options.how: The record's reading of your 09:46 CST answer: the refusal lifts at once when the revert merges, with its run still going. The merge tool and the decision change.
options.label: Merges resume when the revert merges
options.lose: A revert that itself breaks main would reopen merges onto a red main.

reply: Filed 13:21 CST: your 745 b is ruling own-745-b-resume-at-revert. Merges resume when the revert merges. The decision and the merge tool change; step red-main-owner-two-picks carries it. The coordinator starts the lane.
short: Red main: resume at the revert's merge or its green run?

shown.label: Merges resume when the revert's own run on main is green (recommended)
Merges resume when the revert merges

title: After a red main, should merges resume when the revert merges, or when the revert's own run on main is green?
why: Two of your own answers differ; a merge check changes either way.
